metadata.model_selection: highest validation F1 across feature segment, layer and classifier
metadata.threshold_selection: validation F1 on the training split only
metadata.feature_scaling: StandardScaler fit within each model pipeline on training partition only

train_feature_metadata.pooling: Per-field attention-mask mean pooling. Question, context and answer are tokenized independently; each representation averages every attended token in that field, including tokenizer-added special tokens. Each field truncates independently at max_length.
train_feature_metadata.representation_type: Observer-model representations; not necessarily the original answer-generating model's activations.
train_feature_metadata.row_order: row_index and row_id correspond to this split CSV order

test_feature_metadata.pooling: Per-field attention-mask mean pooling. Question, context and answer are tokenized independently; each representation averages every attended token in that field, including tokenizer-added special tokens. Each field truncates independently at max_length.
test_feature_metadata.representation_type: Observer-model representations; not necessarily the original answer-generating model's activations.
test_feature_metadata.row_order: row_index and row_id correspond to this split CSV order
